svg.title: Power to detect a real 5% lift, by window length
svg.desc: Animated. The bell curve is the distribution of lifts you would observe if the instruction change truly improved the score by 5 percent. The vertical line is the significance threshold. The shaded area to its right is the share of runs that would be called significant. At a 14-day window that area is 44 percent; it does not pass 80 percent until roughly 38 days.
svg.text: If the edit truly works, how often does the gate notice?
Sampling distribution of the observed lift, given a real +0.35 point (5%) effect
